description: This file defines the 'RealDistribution' interface in the Apache Commons Math library, outlining the abstract methods for probability density functions, cumulative functions, quantiles, and sampling behavior for real-valued probability distributions.

classes.name: RealDistribution
classes.description: An interface specifying the contract for real-valued probability distributions, including methods for probability density, cumulative probabilities, quantiles, moments, support bounds, and sample generation.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample of specified size from the distribution.
